A small team on the ground, dedicated to moving your talent

We are not a platform. When you call, you speak to the person who will choose your employee's housing.

What we believe

Housing employees well is a productivity decision. Someone who sleeps well, does not spend an hour commuting each morning and knows who to call when something goes wrong does better work. And keeps a good memory of the company that sent them.

Eden Corporate Mobility was founded on that observation. Our mission: simplify your operations and give every employee a premium experience, from departure to return.

The people who pick up the phone

Three people, complementary skills, one goal: every employee well settled, and nothing left for you to manage.

FH

Flore Hountondji

Founder, property manager and mobility manager

Flore selects every property and coordinates each employee's move, from the first search to the day they settle in.

TR

Tom Rurik

Business developer

Tom works with client companies to understand each assignment and identify housing that fits it, with a reliable, tailored approach.

AP

Anna Prevost

Head of premium services

Anna builds the personalised services that make a stay simpler and more pleasant: welcome, concierge, activities.

How we work

Based in the Paris region, we work in English and French with French and European companies.

We select
We do not forward lists of properties. We choose the ones that fit the assignment, and we stand behind that choice.
We answer fast
One call, one answer. We know every request has an arrival date getting closer.
We say what we do
A clear quote, written terms, no hidden fees. If we cannot do something, we say so.
